sn20.11:1.2: Assuttha no tumhe bhikkhave rattiyā paccusasamayaṃ siṅgālassa vassamānassāti || ||
sn20.11:1.4: Eso kho bhikkhave jarasiṅgālo ukkaṇṇakena nāma rogajātena phuṭṭho ||
sn20.11:1.5: So yena yena icchati tena tena gacchati ||
sn20.11:1.6: yattha yattha icchati tattha tattha tiṭṭhati ||
sn20.11:1.7: yattha yattha icchati tattha tattha nisīdati ||
sn20.11:1.8: yattha yattha icchati attha tattha nippajjati ||
sn20.11:1.10: Sādhu khvassa bhikkhave yam idhekacco sakyaputtiyapatiñño evarūpaṃ pi attabhāvapatilābhaṃ paṭisaṃvediyetha || || 5
sn20.11:1.11: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ || ||
